verdict.rationale: Gemini is an AI assistant/agent, which plays the MCP client role. Serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The Gemini CLI evidence only shows configuring and consuming MCP servers, which is client-side and is not credited here. The runtime probe found no MCP server card or MCP discovery surface on the Gemini app, and nothing shows Gemini itself running as an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
